Container.Name: flameboss-hub
Container.Overview: Local replacement for the Flame Boss / EGG Genius grill app. Talks to the controller on your network with no cloud, shows live pit and meat temperatures, lets you change the target, records every cook with a graph and notes, and can pass the grill on to Home Assistant. Enter the controller's IP address and PIN on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Home Assistant port
Config.Description: Built-in broker the Flame Boss Home Assistant integration can connect to instead of the grill. Uses 1884 on the host so it doesn't clash with another MQTT broker.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Your time zone, so cook times look right.
